summary_1line: After Bhima kills Kichaka, his relatives try to burn Draupadi with the corpse, but Bhima rescues her and slaughters over a hundred of them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima uproots a massive tree and charges toward the Kichaka clan like a furious lion while they drag Draupadi toward the funeral pyre.
The Kichakas bind Draupadi and place her on Kichaka’s funeral bier as torches flicker on the way to the cemetery.
Bhima stands towering with the uprooted tree on his shoulder while terrified Sutas scatter in panic across the dark cremation ground.
